verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Omarchy can be installed to a single partition alongside Windows or other installations, and point to a dedicated manual page on dual booting beside Windows. That directly delivers the dual-boot story. missing for 10: in-pack detail of the dual-boot procedure (partitioning and bootloader handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of a dual-boot install

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install the OS alongside my existing OS in a dual-boot configuration

citations.quote: In Omarchy Quattro, you're able to install Omarchy to a single partition alongside Windows or other installations.
The manual also covers dual booting beside Windows and unattended installs.
